facts.text: Club InterContinental is a private lounge high above the city with panoramic views of Perth City.
facts.excerpt: Escape to Club InterContinental, a private sanctuary high above the bustling city and enjoy panoramic vistas of Perth City and tailored service, heightened luxury, and exclusive benefits throughout your stay.

facts.text: Club InterContinental offers a la carte breakfast, all-day refreshments, afternoon tea and evening canapes.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a la carte breakfast, all day refreshments, afternoon tea, and evening canapes.

facts.text: The Loft Lounge & Bar's terrace is set against the backdrop of His Majesty's Theatre and historic Hay Street.
facts.excerpt: Set against the backdrop of His Majesty’s Theatre and historic Hay Street, enjoy your evening on the terrace or at a comfortable lounge table beside the bar.

facts.text: The Loft Lounge & Bar has an outdoor terrace amid Perth's heritage facades, serving classic cocktails and Western Australian wines.
facts.excerpt: Discover Worldly Classic Cocktails, enjoy fine Western Australian wines, and taste an array of culinary delights from the outdoor terrace, amidst Perth’s heritage facades.

facts.text: The Loft Lounge & Bar has live music every Friday.
facts.excerpt: Experience the elegance of live music, expertly crafted cocktails, and gourmet dishes every Friday from 4:30 PM.

facts.text: Ascua has a theatre-style open kitchen with a wood-fired grill, cooking Western Australian produce.
facts.excerpt: The theatre-style open kitchen will be a focal point of your visit, showcasing a sizzling wood-fired grill as artisanal chefs prepare only the freshest Western Australian produce, cooked to perfection.

facts.text: Heno & Rey serves Spanish tapas with alfresco dining on the corner of King and Hay Street.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a lively Spanish atmosphere full of warmth, music, and laughter alongside authentic tapas dishes and alfresco dining on the corner of King and Hay Street.

facts.text: The hotel has two restaurants and one bar.
facts.excerpt: Our two restaurants and one bar showcase some of the best Western Australian produce.

facts.text: Ascua offers chef-led tomahawk and seafood masterclasses at its wood-fire grill.
facts.excerpt: Step behind Ascua’s wood-fire grill for an exclusive, chef-led experience.

facts.text: Each masterclass includes recipes and a trio of Ascua's signature sea salts to take home.
facts.excerpt: Each two-hour experience includes recipes and a trio of Ascua’s signature sea salts to take home.

facts.text: Ascua masterclasses need a minimum of two guests and advance booking.
facts.excerpt: minimum two guests. Advance bookings essential.

facts.text: Le Petit Chef dining experience is offered at Gallery Suites at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Discover the wonder of Le Petit Chef at Gallery Suites, InterContinental Perth City Centre.

facts.text: Breakfast features seasonal produce, freshly baked pastries, classic hot dishes, barista coffee and fresh juices.
facts.excerpt: Ease into the day with a relaxed breakfast featuring seasonal produce, freshly baked pastries and a selection of classic hot dishes, complemented by barista coffee and fresh juices.

facts.text: Ascua calls itself home to Perth's finest tomahawk steaks and seafood.
facts.excerpt: Home to Perth’s finest tomahawk steaks and seafood.
